notes: The original dated 2018-10-09 three-page partial notice (SHA-256 F3F304ED79D64EAE50D9833EAF5DF1EB2D8681ACD12937C0665011BCF3B033C5) covered eight clinical subjects. The supplied four-page 1398 full list (PDF title «لیست منابع آزمون ورودی دستیاری دندانپزشکی سال ۱۳۹۸», PDF created 2018-10-13, modified 2018-10-29, SHA-256 E6409765D78B6FB8ACE629F466235C33AC23026A6AF3B9E88D5C9C89743DD7D8, konkur.in watermark) includes four additional subjects: oral pathology, three prosthodontic references, community oral health and dental materials. Old row-level provenance is preserved; newly added rows identify the supplied full list. English is a level statement (Upper Intermediate), not a book. The printed Falace/Little 2018 '12th' and van Noort 2014 year are retained as transcribed claims; canonical edition identities are 9e and 4e, respectively. The supplied mirror has not been independently authenticated against a Ministry-hosted original.
